{{Top}}
[[File:Kwilaan_tapestry.png|thumb|150px|A [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] tapestry depicting [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]]]]
'''Tapestries''' were pieces of woven, heavy textile fabric characterized by complicated pictorial designs and that were used as wall hangings. Such items often depicted famous individuals or historical events&mdash;in which case they were known as [[Heritage tapestry|heritage tapestries]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Some were precious pieces of art<ref name="LFC">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian}}</ref><ref name="NoP">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref> and could usually be found in [[palace]]s and [[Castle/Legends|castles]] across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="XW:SA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref><ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> as well as in prestigious places such as the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TFU" /> Tapestries could be woven out of various materials including [[silkweed]] from [[Kushibah]],<ref name="SKW">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Anakin's Quest]]''</ref> [[Guarlara/Legends|Guarlara]] underfur,<ref name="WLSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> or [[Fiberplast/Legends|fiberplast]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
